sections.heading: Identity and time
sections.text: Tags verified against C17/V17 in D02 and the WP-031 tag schedule. The records cover 13:00:00 to 13:24:00 on 14 October 2024, synchronized with CAM-3. They do not use the circuit nickname as identity.

sections.heading: Measured quantities
sections.text: V17 CLOSED indication remains 1. The calibrated meter on the only C17-to-return route through V17 records 0.400 +/- 0.010 litres leaving the chamber. External loss is below 0.002 litres; the boundary inspection finds no alternate return route. Instrument checks passed before and after this interval.

sections.heading: Model limits
sections.text: Use 100 cm2 effective area and 1:1 cylinder-to-yoke travel. Within this specified boundary, compression and temperature effects are negligible within the stated uncertainty. No independent block was present. Do not generalize these simplifications to an unspecified machine.

sections.heading: Interpretation boundary
sections.text: The meter records chamber fluid leaving through the tagged route despite closed-position indication. It does not establish valve wear age, contamination, prior inspection decisions or why the carrier bypassed its keeper.
